Description & Benefits: Truncates sparse tensor networks via SVD, simulating n=40+ with low-rank inputs; exploits sparsity in noisy gates for rank bounding. Benefits: 3–10x memory savings; 2–4x speedup in entanglement-heavy LRET evolutions.
Pseudocode (C++-Inspired):

Input: Sparse L, SVD cutoff
Output: L_approx

// Build sparse TN
tn = sparse_tn_from_circuit(L.circuit);
// Parallel truncate
#pragma omp parallel for
for tensor in tn:
if sparsity(tensor) > 0.5: U, S, V = svd(tensor);
S[S < cutoff] = 0; // Sparsify
tensor = U * diag(S) * V†;
// Recontract
L_approx = tn.contract_optimal_path();
return L_approx;
